notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
You have Professor Dellian Fel's emblem.
description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Professor Dellian Fel's emblem triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
